reply_text:
I didn't record 25 November as the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date, because our records say 30 November 2026. I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread to ask where the new date came from.

What the records show:
- The signed renewal order form for 2025-26 was executed 21 Nov 2025. It sets the end of the current term, which it calls the renewal date, at 30 November 2026.
- The account profile was last updated 30 Sep 2026; Marcus Lindqvist owns the account. It also says the term ends 30 November.
- An older CRM note from February 2026 says 31 December 2026, which conflicts with the signed order form.
- Nothing I found mentions 25 November.

I asked Ilse whether an amendment or a customer request changed the date, and told her I'll keep 30 November as the date of record until she points me to one. Renewal dates aren't finance figures, so the reply didn't need approval, and it doesn't include any prices or discounts.
